name: code-loops
description: Review loop and docs check for Claude Code: review and fix a branch diff until nothing is left, and check that the documentation matches the code.

pre_push_review.title: Ask for the review before a push
pre_push_review.description: Block the first git push of each commit until /code-loops:review-loop has run (the commits of its fixes then go through once). Turn it off when another rule already asks for the review before a push
